verdict.rationale: Mistral documents official Python/TypeScript SDKs, function calling/tool use, an Agents API with tools, handoffs, and explicit MCP support for connecting to agent frameworks, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: no evidence of official first-party plugins/skills for specific named coding agents (e.g. Copilot, Cursor, Continue) or an agent-framework marketplace listing, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of these integrations working in practice.
